title: Dilution with CSV File and Custom Tube Rack
author: Opentrons
materials: Sample and diluent is mixed after dispensing sample.

steps.title: Create CSV transfer file
steps.instruction: Prepare a .csv file that includes the header line "Diluent Transfer Volume (ul), Dispense Tube (rack), Source Well, Sample Transfer Volume" and a row for each transfer, e.g., "1000, A1, A1, 20". Save the file for use by the protocol.

steps.title: Configure pipettes and tip racks
steps.instruction: Mount the P20 and P1000 pipettes on the specified robot mounts (left or right). Load tip racks onto the deck. Set the tip‑tracking option to start at A1 of each rack or to continue from the previous run, as desired.

substeps.instruction: Place tip racks on the deck.
Select tip‑tracking mode (start at A1 or continue).

steps.title: Set temperature module to 4 °C
steps.instruction: Place the custom 40‑tube rack in slot 1 of the temperature module and set the module temperature to 4 °C.

steps.title: Load diluent rack and set initial volume
steps.instruction: Place the 6‑tube diluent rack on the deck, enter the initial volume of diluent in well A1 (in mL) in the protocol parameters, and enable liquid‑height tracking for that rack.

steps.title: Transfer diluent to final rack
steps.instruction: For each row in the CSV, use a fresh tip, aspirate the specified Diluent Transfer Volume (µL) from the Source Well in the diluent rack with the appropriate pipette, dispense into the indicated Dispense Tube in the final rack, and discard the tip. Use a new tip for each diluent transfer to accommodate low viscosity.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate Diluent Transfer Volume (µL) from Source Well.
Dispense into Dispense Tube (rack) in slot 1.

steps.title: Transfer sample and mix
steps.instruction: For each row in the CSV, use a fresh tip, aspirate the Sample Transfer Volume (µL) from the Source Well, dispense into the same Dispense Tube, perform a mixing motion (e.g., 3 × 10 µL aspirate/dispense), then discard the tip to avoid cross‑contamination.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate Sample Transfer Volume (µL) from Source Well.
Dispense into the same Dispense Tube.
